title: Modified Salting Out Method for High Molecular Weight gDNA Extraction
author: Hüsna ztoprak

steps.title: Submerge cleansed specimen in 195 µL...
steps.instruction: Submerge cleansed specimen in 195 µL TNES buffer and flash freeze by holding tube in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Homogenize specimen with pestle
steps.instruction: Using a sterile pestle, homogenize by applying pressure to grind the specimen between pestlehead and the walls of the tube. If low DNA yield is expected. Leave pestle in tube to ensure maximum digestion of material.Consider including multiple (3x) freeze and thaw cycles and vortexing to disrupt tissue fully.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize specimen by pressing sterile pestle against tube walls
If low DNA yield is expected, leave pestle in tube for maximum digestion
Perform three freeze‑thaw cycles and vortex to fully disrupt tissue

steps.title: Add 5 µL proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL proteinase K.

steps.title: Vortex for 00:00:03
steps.instruction: Vortex for 00:00:03 . Centrifuge briefly.

steps.title: Incubate at 55 °C for ~ 01:00:00
steps.instruction: Incubate at 55 °C for ~ 01:00:00 . Completely dissolve the specimen.

steps.title: If there is indigestible debris left...
steps.instruction: If there is indigestible debris left over centrifuge 18000 rcf, , 5 minutes and transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube.

steps.title: Add 1
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 µL yeast tRNA, flick to mix briefly then spin down.

steps.title: Add 65 µL 5 Molarity (M)...
steps.instruction: Add 65 µL 5 Molarity (M) NaCl and 290 µL 96% EtOH, mix by inversion.

steps.title: This should clarify the solution
steps.instruction: This should clarify the solution. Store at -20 °C for 01:00:00 . Solution can be stored Overnight at this step.

steps.title: Optional
steps.instruction: Optional : add 1 µL Pellet Paint Co-Precipitant (for colorful pellet).

steps.title: Spin down at 18000 rcf, 4 °C, 15 minutes
steps.instruction: Spin down at 18000 rcf, 4 °C, 15 minutes . Know the expected position of the DNA pellet, as it can be difficult to see.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant.

steps.title: Add 0
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL chilled 70% EtOH (make fresh).

steps.title: Spin at 18000 rcf, , 5 minutes
steps.instruction: Spin at 18000 rcf, , 5 minutes .

steps.title: Repeat ethanol rinse
steps.instruction: Repeat ethanol rinse.

steps.title: Leave tube open to air dry
steps.instruction: Leave tube open to air dry. Pellet should have a glassy appearance.

steps.title: Using a wide-bore pipette tip, add...
steps.instruction: Using a wide-bore pipette tip, add 21 µL TE Buffer (elution buffer) and gently resuspend the DNA pellet with pipette mixing.

steps.title: Add 2 µL RNase Cocktail
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL RNase Cocktail. Incubate at 37 °C for approx. 01:00:00 . Note : For femto pulse systems elution in TE Buf er, more specifically EDTA is not recommended. Alternatively use 0.1 mM EDTA or EB, Tris-HCl (pH 8-8.5).

steps.title: To observe the specimen under a...
steps.instruction: To observe the specimen under a microscope, cleansed specimens are placed on a sterile slide and submerged with TNES buffer until fully covered.

steps.title: Remove one genital plate cautiously with...
steps.instruction: Remove one genital plate cautiously with a sharp needle and stir tissue without destroying theexoskeleton.

steps.instruction: Transfer specimen in 195 µL TNES buffer.

steps.title: Add 5 µL proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL proteinase K.

steps.title: Incubate at 37 °C Overnight
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C Overnight .

steps.instruction: Transfer specimen with sterile needle to a tube containing 70% EtOH and store it for morphological analysis.
